crossRefs.note: My son, if your heart is wise, then my heart will be glad, even mine.
Keep your heart with all diligence, for out of it is the wellspring of life.
You shall love Yahweh your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your might.
He who loves father or mother more than me is not worthy of me; and he who loves son or daughter more than me isn’t…
He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me, isn’t worthy of me.
“If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and…
For the love of Christ constrains us; because we judge thus, that one died for all, therefore all died.
He died for all, that those who live should no longer live to themselves, but to him who for their sakes died and rose…
This was not as we had expected, but first they gave their own selves to the Lord, and to us through the will of God.
that Christ may dwell in your hearts through faith, to the end that you, being rooted and grounded in love,
Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
Whoever is wise will pay attention to these things. They will consider the loving kindnesses of Yahweh.
Blessed are those who keep his statutes, who seek him with their whole heart.
How can a young man keep his way pure? By living according to your word.
Who is wise, that he may understand these things? Who is prudent, that he may know them? For the ways of Yahweh are…
We have the more sure word of prophecy; and you do well that you heed it, as to a lamp shining in a dark place, until…

translations.web: My son, give me your heart; and let your eyes keep in my ways.
translations.bsb: My son, give me your heart, and let your eyes delight in my ways.
translations.kjv: My son, give me thine heart, and let thine eyes observe my ways.
translations.asv: My son, give me thy heart; And let thine eyes delight in my ways.
